summary.en: Kogoro received a letter from a mysterious person called "Kurataya Komakichi", saying he wanted to give him his family treasure. So, Ran and Conan decided to accompany him to Yamaguchi. Robbery-Atempted Murder (Past) Location: Yamaguchi City Victim: Akihiko Takarada Missing items: Gold bars Culprit: Kurataya Komakichi Kurataya Komakichi stole golden bars worth a lot of money in Takarada's shop and shot him. Location: Yamaguchi City Victim: Asuka Natsume Culprit: Kurataya Komakichi
